svg.title: Muster | Membership and message-delivery ER views
svg.desc: Separate bounded views keep notation readable; repeated User boxes represent the same physical users collection. Conventional crow’s-foot cardinalities, square entity tables, and undirected relationship lines.

g.text: Muster | Membership and message-delivery ER views
Separate bounded views keep notation readable; repeated User boxes represent the same physical users collection.
PK = document identifier UQ = unique index FK = logical ObjectId reference ? = nullable / optional
Dashed = non-identifying reference; each document has its own _id. Solid = embedded ownership, not a separate collection.
Team.members[] and closedRoster[] are embedded values. Team.members.userId is indexed with eventId but is NOT unique or a member primary key.
An invite may target an unregistered email, so invitedUser is nullable. Pending (teamId, invitedEmail) uniqueness uses a partial index.
EmailJob may exist without a Notification or registered recipient. Neither optional reference is unique: the physical model allows many jobs.
Other EmailJob and Notification subject refs are shown in rows; contextual links do not establish required parent relationships.
Operational collections and polymorphic audit targets are omitted here; see the full relationship catalog.
